summaries.worklogs-recorder: Writes the dated worklog of a session in `worklogs/` from what was really run and changed, as a new file that is never rewritten; backs one up
summaries.worklogs-workflow: How work is done in `worklogs/`: what a worklog is, its name, collect, write, leave it; the commands, the settings keys
summaries.worklogs-write: `/worklogs-write <subject> [date]`: names the file, collects what happened and writes the worklog of the session
summaries.worklogs-record-this-session: A new session that records a working session as a dated worklog
